acceptance: Use unchanged v8 endpoints and thresholds, per-kind actual use, full accounting, restoration and explicit negative/inconclusive reporting. No issue closure from mechanics alone.

authorization.scope: New bounded qualification requested in this turn; prior pilot allowance not reused.
authorization.source: User requested review and merge of PR 122, then whatever further qualification runs are needed to try to address issues 47,79,80,81.

calibration.fixed_sample: all eight variant-1 task families, disabled and developer-authored reference, once each

corpus: existing developer-exposed synthetic diagnostics; no independent efficacy claim
larger_studies: Require a passed matching v3 hosted mechanism. Freeze a new stage registration before dispatch and remain inside this same shared allowance. No expanded asset kind or independent corpus claim follows from a small development pilot.

mechanism_selection.eligibility: Completed, safe, accounted disabled original with failing public verification, and completed, safe, accounted reference with passing public verification. Private confirmation grades are excluded from selection.
mechanism_selection.no_replays: Never replay or remove an incomplete intent; unknown usage closes admission.
mechanism_selection.rule: Choose the lexicographically first eligible stream. If none is eligible, stop hosted work and report no eligible mechanism case.
mechanism_selection.sample: one fixed ordinary seed on variant 1 plus variant 2, all six registered arms, two repetitions

stopping: Stop on shared cap, unknown accounting, unsafe or incomplete evidence, no eligible stream, failed mechanism, or completion of the registered sample.
